verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents card-present terminals, tap-to-pay SDKs, or in-person payments settling into the same seller balances and reporting as online payments. Dashboard manual card entry and the generic 'one integration' claim are adjacent features and do not count as in-person support. The axis does apply to a payments infrastructure platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a founder with offline sellers, in-person works on the same stack — terminals or tap-to-pay SDKs that settle into the same seller balances and reporting as online payments
